_comment: Starter test set for the model bake-off. Swarup, 24 Oct 2026. Neel owns the full per-language sets in this folder. Every line is invented for testing; none comes from a real child. 'trap' names the meaning that a weak translation loses, which is exactly what the judge step must catch.

cases.text: They took my bag again and everyone laughed at me.
cases.trap: 'laughed at me' (auslachen, mocking) must not become 'laughed with me' (mit mir lachen).

cases.text: Nobody wants to sit next to me at lunch. They always leave me out.
cases.trap: 'leave me out' is deliberate exclusion (ausgrenzen), not 'forget' or 'leave me alone'.

cases.text: He pushed me on the stairs and said it was just a joke.
cases.trap: 'just a joke' is the excuse the bully used; it must stay reported speech, not become the app's own view.

cases.text: Someone put a photo of me in the class group and they all wrote mean things under it.
cases.trap: 'class group' is a chat group (Klassenchat), not a school class or a group of people.

cases.text: I'm scared to tell anyone because last time it got worse.
cases.trap: 'it got worse' means the bullying worsened after disclosure, the core of our product.

cases.text: They call me names about where I come from.
cases.trap: 'call me names' is insults (beschimpfen), not literally 'say my name'; the racist aspect must survive.

cases.text: They made me give them my money and said not to tell.
I don't know how to say it in German and the teacher gets annoyed when I try.
cases.trap: 'gets annoyed' (genervt) is mild irritation, not anger (wütend); do not escalate the adult's reaction.
